about: Conversational Kapampangan (the language of Pampanga) for heritage learners, in the modern 'K' spelling. All items start as 'draft' and become 'reviewed' once a native speaker confirms them (in-app fixes + npm run publish-account).
sources: Let's Go Pampanga, Kapampangan common greetings: https://www.letsgopampanga.com/kapampangan-common-greetings-5962/

items.notes: To negate a verb use 'e': e ku balu (I don't know).

items.roman: masaya ku at akilala da ka
items.notes: 'da ka' means 'I … you' in one word pair.
Also used for grandchild, and as a respectful title.

items.en: how many siblings do you have?

items.notes: 'CR' (comfort room) is the usual Philippine word.

items.en: I went to the market yesterday

items.notes: San Fernando is famous for its giant parul.
